title: Analytics Vendor Exception Override

sections.text: INTENTIONAL CONFLICT FOR TESTING: The Analytics Director may approve Vendor X access to Dataset Z on a project-by-project basis.

metadata.scanner_note: This OVERRIDE conflicts with VR-001 which broadly restricts Vendor X from all data access.

sections.text: This applies only to Dataset Z, not Dataset Y.

metadata.scanner_note: Even if this override were valid, Dataset Y remains prohibited for Vendor X under VR-001 and DS-001-v5.

source: Analytics Department — Experimental Exception Policy v1.0 (CONFLICT DOCUMENT — for policy scanner testing)
